concerns.text: The /.well-known endpoints generate relative API URLs (e.g. /api/v1/articles/...) instead of fully qualified absolute URLs, which external LLM web crawlers may prefer when indexing cross-domain.
The concept_links field is stored as a plain comma-separated TEXT column rather than a normalized relational table or JSON array, limiting SQL querying flexibility for individual concept links.
TelegramSparkMapper relies on simple hashtag extraction for domain mapping, which defaults to unassigned or general domain if expected hashtags are omitted in Telegram posts.
